title: Act: Compute and refresh zoom in PhaserHost
summary: Use computeZoom at mount, on resize and on dpr change
description: PhaserHost computes the zoom from the container size and window.devicePixelRatio, passes it to createGame, and re-applies it via scale.setZoom plus scale.refresh on resize and ratio change.
acceptance_criteria: Resize and dpr change call setZoom then refresh

steps.action: Define const currentZoom = () => computeZoom(container.clientWidth, container.clientHeight, window.devicePixelRatio) once container is non-null; pass currentZoom() as third argument to createGame; in the ResizeObserver callback call game.scale.setZoom(currentZoom()) then game.scale.refresh(); also register a matchMedia(`(resolution: ${window.devicePixelRatio}dppx)`) 'change' listener (only if window.matchMedia exists) running the same update, and remove it in cleanup.
steps.expected: Zoom passed at creation and refreshed on resize and dpr change
